# `ceangal.color`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py from ceangal/src/color.almd; do not edit. -->

_Colour strings, lighten / darken / mix, WCAG contrast._

Colors as apps write them: parsing CSS-style strings (#rgb, #rgba,
#rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(), hsl(), hsla()), writing them back,
lightening, darkening, saturating, turning the hue, mixing, and WCAG
luminance and contrast. It behaves as tinycolor2 1.6.0 does, checked
against the results recorded in tests/absorb/color.txt (ADR 0023); its
code was written here from that behaviour, not taken from tinycolor2.

```almide
import ceangal.color
```

### `Swatch`

```almide
type Swatch = { r: Float, g: Float, b: Float, a: Float }
```

Red, green and blue from 0 to 255 (not rounded), alpha from 0 to 1. (Not
named Rgba: snaidhm.vector has an Rgba, and a type takes over another
package's type of the same name, almide/almide#3472.)

```almide
type Hsla = { h: Float, s: Float, l: Float, a: Float }
```

### `Num`

```almide
type Num = { v: Float, pct: Bool, ok: Bool }
```

A number in a color string: its value, whether it had "%", whether it parsed.

## Parsing

### `parse`

```almide
pub fn parse(s: String) -> Option[Swatch]
```

The color `s` describes, if it is one of the forms above.

## Writing

### `to_hex`

```almide
pub fn to_hex(c: Swatch) -> String
```

"#rrggbb".

### `to_hex8`

```almide
pub fn to_hex8(c: Swatch) -> String
```

"#rrggbbaa".

### `to_rgb_string`

```almide
pub fn to_rgb_string(c: Swatch) -> String
```

"rgb(r, g, b)", or "rgba(r, g, b, a)" when not opaque.

### `to_hsl_string`

```almide
pub fn to_hsl_string(c: Swatch) -> String
```

"hsl(h, s%, l%)", or "hsla(h, s%, l%, a)" when not opaque.

## Changing

### `to_hsl`

```almide
pub fn to_hsl(c: Swatch) -> Hsla
```

Hue in degrees (0–360), saturation and lightness as fractions.

### `from_hsl`

```almide
pub fn from_hsl(x: Hsla) -> Swatch
```

A color from hue (degrees), saturation and lightness (fractions).

### `lighten`

```almide
pub fn lighten(c: Swatch, amount: Float) -> Swatch
```

Lighter by `amount` percentage points of lightness.

### `darken`

```almide
pub fn darken(c: Swatch, amount: Float) -> Swatch
```

Darker by `amount` percentage points of lightness.

### `saturate`

```almide
pub fn saturate(c: Swatch, amount: Float) -> Swatch
```

More saturated by `amount` percentage points.

### `desaturate`

```almide
pub fn desaturate(c: Swatch, amount: Float) -> Swatch
```

Less saturated by `amount` percentage points.

### `spin`

```almide
pub fn spin(c: Swatch, degrees: Float) -> Swatch
```

The hue turned by `degrees` (either way).

### `mix`

```almide
pub fn mix(a: Swatch, b: Swatch, amount: Float) -> Swatch
```

`a` mixed with `b`: `amount` percent of the way from a to b.

## Luminance and contrast (WCAG 2)

### `luminance`

```almide
pub fn luminance(c: Swatch) -> Float
```

Relative luminance, from 0 (black) to 1 (white).

### `contrast`

```almide
pub fn contrast(a: Swatch, b: Swatch) -> Float
```

The contrast ratio of two colors, from 1 to 21.

### `readable`

```almide
pub fn readable(a: Swatch, b: Swatch) -> Bool
```

Whether text in one color is readable on the other: WCAG AA for normal
text (a contrast ratio of 4.5 or more).

For drawing (snaidhm's channels are fractions).

```almide
pub fn from_color(c: snaidhm.Color) -> Swatch
```

A drawing color as a swatch.
